facts.text: I love how technology has made it possible for independent filmmakers to gain more recognition and share their stories with a wider audience.
I miss going to the theater.
I find it convenient to stream a movie from my couch.
I think there is something special about going to the theater with friends or family to see a movie.
I think theaters always have the best movie snacks.
I am excited to see how the film industry will continue to adapt and innovate with technology.
I am especially interested in advancements like virtual reality and augmented reality for movies.
